description: Opposite Setup cancels an unfinished (active or deferred) Countdown before it can count; the cancelled side is re-admitted later.

cases.derivation: Buy Setup 9 at 13 (perfect), counts 1,2. 15..23 rise: sell run 1..9, sell Setup 9 at 23 (imperfect: T=111 from the spike bar 21, max(h22,h23)=104). Bar 23 would be a buy count (103<=l21=109), but P2 cancels the buy Countdown first: countdown_cancel carries episode 13 and the old references (count 2, nulls); no buy count. P1 sell: setup_complete, countdown_start; no sell count at 23 (103<h21=111). 24: sell count 1 (104>=h22=101). 25: buy idle, no count though 100<=l23=102.

First 25 bars as the main case. 26..33 close 99..92: buy run 1 at 25 .. 9 at 33, a distinct Setup 9. The buy side is idle after the cancel, so a fresh Countdown is admitted (episode 33). Bar 33 shows P1 (buy setup_complete with replaced_episode_id 13, perfection (T=93, min(l32,l33)=91), countdown_start), P2 (sell cancel: episode 23, count 1, nulls), P3 (buy count 1: 92<=l31=93). The idle buy side counted nothing 26..32; the sell Countdown counted nothing (falling).
